core_categories: Hospital Care; Aesculap; Out Patient Market; B. Braun Avitum
specialty_focus: B. Braun is a global medical technology and pharmaceutical company that develops and manufactures healthcare products. It operates through four divisions: Hospital Care (infusion systems, IV drugs, clinical nutrition, anesthesia), Aesculap (surgical instruments, implants), Out Patient Market (wound management, ostomy care, diabetes therapies), and B. Braun Avitum (dialysis equipment). It does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
